body:
## Why
Every liveness judgement is a wall-clock subtraction, so a laptop sleep longer than `max_runtime` has the first tick write local attempts off as `timed_out`, and no pause verb can be safe before the clocks know the word (`docs/local-first.md` §5, §11).

## What
1. `src/model.js`: `attemptElapsed(a, now)` and `sinceSignal(a, now)`, pure, subtracting `a.pauses` (`[{ at, until, by }]`; an open pause has `until: null` and counts to `now`). Tests for: no pauses, one closed, one open, overlapping windows clipped.
2. `src/dispatch.js`: `max_runtime`, `stale_after`, the idle threshold and `recent_success_window` checks use them; the reclaim loop skips an attempt whose row has an open pause (`paused_at` set) entirely.
3. The loop stamps `state.last_tick_at`; a tick that finds `now - last_tick_at > 3 × interval` logs `host slept Ns; N attempts paused for the gap`, appends `{ at: last_tick_at, until: now, by: 'sleep' }` to `pauses[]` of every open attempt with a local handle (`pid`, `job` or `bg`; never `manual`), one `saveRun` each after a **fresh** `loadRun`, and does not reclaim any of them on that tick.
4. `docs/wiki/features/up-and-down.md`: a section "A sleep is a pause".

## Done when
- [ ] `test/dispatch.test.js`: with an injected clock jumping three hours between two ticks, no local attempt is reclaimed or timed out, each gained a `sleep` pause window, and a `manual` attempt past `stale_after` is still reclaimed.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green.

## Contract
`pauses[]` is the field name; the window shape is `{ at, until, by }`; `by` ∈ `sleep | <host> | operator`. B3/B4 write it.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: every liveness subtraction in the tick goes through attemptElapsed/sinceSignal, which subtract pauses[]; a loop that wakes to a gap longer than three intervals writes that window into pauses[] of every local-handle attempt and reclaims nothing local on that tick
title: Clocks and the sleep-aware tick: attemptElapsed, sinceSignal, pauses[], last_tick_at
